description: Completes one step of alignment, as the Complete Review button of its page does. Each step has the condition of its page: financial-views needs each question aligned. For partners-premarital-property, first show the customer each premarital asset of the partner (get_alignment with this step), and get a yes that the customer reviewed them. partners-postmarital-property needs a review of each item of the partner. postmarital-property needs no disagreement of the partner: the customer picks such an item again with set_allocation, and the partner reviews it again. The completion can open the next step and email the customer and the partner. Give the customer next_step, or waiting_for_partner.

confirm.description: True only after the customer said to complete the step.

name: complete_alignment_step

completed_now.description: False when the step was already complete. The tool then changed nothing.

next_step.description: The current module of the customer.

ready_to_complete.description: Each step is complete for both partners: call complete_alignment.

waiting_for_partner.description: Why the next step waits for the partner.

title: Complete an alignment step
